clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the Deadmines, Gilnid runs the goblin forges for the Defias Brotherhood. Known as the Smelter, he oversees the work that turns raw ore into refined metal and munitions for Edwin VanCleef's hidden ironclad juggernaut. His foundry makes the heavy cannons the Brotherhood needs to strike Stormwind.

Deep in the Deadmines, the Defias Brotherhood depends on skilled hands to forge its weapons of war. Gilnid, VanCleef's head smelter, commands goblin laborers, tinkers, and smiths in the central foundry. Taller than most of his kin, he drives them through smoke and slag, barking orders and allowing no breaks. Their work turns raw iron ore into heavy plating and deadly ordnance.
